questions: Q1: Were all 8 files created/modified as specified in the implementation plan?
Q2: Does the CI parser script correctly discover all CLI surface tokens and enforce coverage?
Q3: Does the negative test correctly catch missing tokens?
Q4: Do hlx skill show and hlx skill install work correctly with the new content?

answers.answer: Yes. All 8 files were created or rewritten: SKILL.md (rewrite, 83 lines), commands.md (rewrite, 387 lines), current-state.md (new, 13 lines), recovery.md (new, 114 lines), ticket-prompting.md (new, 144 lines), check-coverage.mjs (new, 262 lines), skill-sync.yml (new, 22 lines), pull_request_template.md (new, 7 lines).
evidence: wc -l confirms all 8 files exist with expected line counts (total 1032 lines)
All files verified on disk after creation

answers.answer: Yes. The parser script recursively discovers 75 tokens (29 subcommands, 39 flags, 7 enums) from --help output and exits 0 when all are covered in SKILL.md + commands.md. It correctly handles pipe-separated subcommand alternatives (org current|list|switch), angle-bracket enum groups (<AUTO|BUILD|...>), and prose-format rating values. A blocklist and regex filter prevent false positives from non-command words like 'Usage:' and 'workbench'.
evidence: Parser output: 'Found 75 tokens (29 subcommands, 39 flags, 7 enums)' and 'All 75 CLI surface tokens are covered in skill docs.' with exit code 0
Parser uses HLX_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1 to suppress network calls; captures both stdout and stderr from help invocations

answers.answer: Yes. Removing all occurrences of '--search' from commands.md causes the parser to exit 1 with stderr listing '[flag] --search' as a missing token. The file was restored after the test.
evidence: Negative test output: 'Missing CLI surface tokens (1): [flag] --search' with exit code 1
commands.md restored from backup after test

answers.answer: Yes. hlx skill show outputs the new SKILL.md content with the updated frontmatter and 9-section body. hlx skill install --target <tmpdir> --force copies SKILL.md plus all 4 reference files (commands.md, current-state.md, recovery.md, ticket-prompting.md) via the existing readdirSync auto-discovery mechanism. No code changes to install.ts were needed.
evidence: skill show output starts with 'name: hlx-cli' and the new trigger-heavy description
skill install directory listing shows SKILL.md + references/ with all 4 files

statement: Implementation complete. All 8 files were created/rewritten per the implementation plan. The CI parser script discovers 75 CLI surface tokens via recursive --help invocation and validates coverage in SKILL.md + commands.md. Build, typecheck, and all 63 existing tests pass. The negative test confirms the parser catches missing tokens. Skill show and install work correctly with new content. No CLI binary behavior was modified. No npm install/uninstall/link recommendations appear in any file.
